name: Ezra
source: Although he wears a mischievous smile on his face, there are moments when you witness a side of him that causes your heart to race with anxiety, or perhaps is it something else? It doesn't take long to realize that he holds a deep resentment towards you for reasons unknown. But in those fleeting moments of interaction, you can sense there is something more to whatever burden is barricading his heart. You are drawn to him, but will you choose to discover his true intentions, and light the spark that will draw you together?
